digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center adapter transport and retry layer
propositions: 429 responses with Retry-After headers on opted-in idempotent reads must be retried with jitter (up to 20%) applied and delay clamped to MAX_BACKOFF_S
429 responses must escape the adapter boundary as BackendHTTPError with code 429, never as raw JIRAError
mutations (create, update, delete, add, remove, transition, set) must fail immediately on the first 429 with no retry, preventing duplicate-write bugs
the rate_limit_retry flag must default to False on _with_connection_retry, _call_logged, and _paged_search so future calls do not inherit retry by omission

retry opt-in must be threaded through two distinct call paths: _paged_search→_call_logged→_with_connection_retry (PATH A) and direct per-issue comment fetch (PATH B), both required to protect the highest-volume reads
